scope: Publish and verify the official human-left, simulation-center, official-result-right AC One three-panel replacement
summary: The replacement video and regenerated poster were pushed to main as zhuhuanan, deployed successfully through GitHub Pages, and the public MP4 was verified byte-for-byte against the supplied source.
evidence: Commit 370d9dea3d40b60071d05bab6ade60ad4f96af3a is present on origin/main and was authored with repository identity zhuhuanan.
GitHub Actions run 34037130324 for demo-pages.yml completed successfully for commit 370d9dea3d40b60071d05bab6ade60ad4f96af3a.
The public MP4 SHA-256 is a46cd8fd3e04715768ddf3fb73cd0baf84497d76c6e954ed528d5a19372bad67, exactly matching the user-supplied source.
The deployed homepage returned the RGB → MANO → EEF → AC One card and its replacement-video source path.
lessons: A cache-busting query parameter is useful for proving replacement of an asset published under an unchanged URL.
Comparing public and source SHA-256 values gives stronger publication evidence than checking HTTP status alone.
limitations: The showcase remains a visual comparison and does not establish real-robot execution or contact-aware cloth simulation.
Browsers that cached the unchanged MP4 URL may need a hard refresh.
next_actions: Use the public demo and MP4 link for review.
Treat physical execution and cloth-contact validation as separate milestones.
